lore.9001: LEARNED DA CRAFT FROM SOMEONE WHO IZ NO LONGER AROUND TA BE ASKED ABOUT IT. HALF DA SPELLS WORK, AN' SO FAR DA HALF DAT DO NOT HAB BEEN DA MORE INTERESTIN' ONES!
lore.9002: SELLS OUT ROOMS BY LOSIN' BADLY ON PURPOSE, DEN WINS DA ONE NOBODY PUT MONEY ON. DA KNEE IZ HELD TOGETHER WIT TAPE AN' CONVICTION!
lore.9003: LOADS A SPELL INTO EVERY CHAMBER AN' HAB NEVER ONCE EXPLAINED WHERE DA BULLETS GO. DA WARRENS TURN OUT PLENTY OF THEORISTS; DIS ONE SHOOTS!
lore.9004: A PUDDLE WIT OPINIONS. WHATEVER IT WAZ BEFORE IT STARTED IMITATIN' OTHER THINGS, IT IZ HONESTLY A LITTLE VAGUE ON DA DETAILS ITSELF!
lore.9005: SWORE DA OATH IN FRONT OF WITNESSES, WHICH IZ DA PART DAT MAKES IT BINDIN'. DA ARMOUR WAZ ALREADY SECONDHAND WHEN IT WAZ HANDED OVER!
lore.9006: HEARS DA SENTENCE A MOMENT BEFORE IT IZ SAID, AN' HAB LEARNED NOT TA ANSWER EARLY. IT IZ EXHAUSTIN' AT PARTIES!
lore.9007: PLAYS ROOMS DAT HOLD NINE PEOPLE AN' TALKS ABOUT DEM AS THOUGH DEY HELD NINE HUNDRED. ONE OF DOZE NUMBERS WILL BE TRUE EVENTUALLY!
lore.9008: WORKS A SMALL ENCHANTMENT INTO EVERYTHIN' DAT LEAVES DA WORKSHOP, MOST OF DEM HARMLESS. DA KETTLE HAB OPINIONS NOW!
lore.9009: CALLS THINGS, AN' DEY COME, WHICH IZ ONLY HALF DA DIFFICULTY. GETTIN' DEM TA LEAVE AGAIN IZ DA PART DA BOOKS SKIP!
lore.9010: LEFT DA ORDER ON GOOD TERMS, OR SO DA LETTER SAYS, AN' STILL KEEPS DA HOURS. DA FAITH SURVIVED DA PAPERWORK BETTER DEN DA PAPERWORK SURVIVED HER!
lore.aleisterCrowley: REFOUNDED DA MAGE GUILD IN DA EARLY 1900S WIT DA BACKIN' OF BRITANNIA'S ROYAL HOUSE, STYLIN' IT AS A PSEUDO-CHIVALRIC ORDER, HENCE DA SIR AN' LADY TITLES ITS LEADERS STILL CARRY. AS OF 2001 HE STANDS AS ONE OF DA GUILD'S THREE PILLARS, REPRESENTIN' DA PAST, AN' HAB SIMPLY REFUSED TA EVER STEP DOWN; NO ONE IN DA GUILD CAN TRULY STAND AGAINST HIM, SINCE HE KNOWS SPELLS EVEN DA GODS DO NOT!
lore.popePetrus: BORN JOSEPH RATZINGER, HE ASCENDED TA DA THRONE OF PETER AS PIETRO II AFTER JOHN PAUL II DIED FROM DA ASSASSINATION ATTEMPT OF MAY 13, 1981. HE HAB DECLARED WAR ON JENNA OF NORTHPOINT, REFUSIN' TA RECOGNIZE HER AS DA SECOND COMIN' AN' BRANDIN' HER DA ANTICHRIST INSTEAD!
lore.draghi: HIS NAME IZ PRINTED ON TENS OF BILLIONS OF BANKNOTES AN' FINANCIAL TRANSACTION LOGS, MORE TIMES DEN DA NAME OF GOD ACROSS EVERY PRINTED BIBLE. DA EURO'S SECURITY STRIP IZ LACED WIT FLECKS OF FANTABLACK SCRAPED FROM DA OMEGA TOWER'S OUTER WALLS, AN' BETWEEN DAT ARCANE RESIDUE AN' DA LAW DAT NAMES IZ POWER, DRAGHI ASCENDED AS DA GODHEAD OF DA MARKET ITSELF, AN ABSTRACT CONCEPT NOW DRIVIN' DA MULTIVERSE'S ECONOMY FROM BEHIND DA SCENES!
lore.billClinton: CURRENT PRESIDENT OF DA FREE STATES OF MIDWEST, ONE OF DA THREE FRAGMENTS DA AMERICAS WAZ SPLIT INTO AFTER INDEPENDENCE NEVER FULLY HAPPENED: DA REPUBLIC OF CASCADIA ON DA EAST COAST, DA FREE STATES OF MIDWEST IN DA CENTER, AN' DA ATLANTIC PROTECTORATE ON DA WEST COAST UNDER BRITANNIA'S CONTROL!
lore.margheritaHack: HEAD OF DA EUROPEAN SPACE AGENCY, CURRENTLY TESTIN' NEW ROCKETS BUILT ALMOST ENTIRELY FROM ARMOR PLATIN' MEANT TA BE CHEWED APART BY ORBITAL DEBRIS, BUYIN' ASTRONAUTS JUST ENOUGH TIME TA CLEAR LOW ORBIT. DA KESSLER SYNDROME TRIGGERED DURIN' DA Y2K EVENT TURNED ANY ORDINARY LAUNCH INTO A COIN FLIP WIT OVER 90% ODDS OF FAILURE!
lore.bubba: A MECHANIC FROM WESTFORD, TEXAS, AN' SOMETHIN' OF A LIVIN' LEGEND. BUILT DA LIMINAL ENGINE HIMSELF, A DEVICE DAT CHEWS THROUGH DIMENSIONAL ENERGY AN' LETS HIM DRIVE ACROSS REALITIES IN A BATTERED CAMPER HE CALLS DA BEAST. HE ONCE SPENT YEARS RUNNIN' ROUTE 666 WIT ERIS, DA GODDESS OF DISCORD, ROBBIN' BANKS BY HAVIN' HER BEND PROBABILITY TA CRACK ANY SAFE!
lore.selene: MADE HER MONEY DA WAY DIS BRANCH OF DA AMERICAS REWARDS: READIN' A MARKET NOBODY ELSE COULD HEAR AN' NEVER ONCE EXPLAININ' DA TRICK. SHE KEEPS A HITMAN'S WARDROBE AN' A BROKER'S MANNERS, AN' DA TWO HAB NEVER BEEN IN CONFLICT, SINCE BOTH TRADES IZ ABOUT KNOWIN' EXACTLY WHAT A THING IZ WORTH TA SOMEBODY ELSE!
lore.andreotti: SEVEN TIMES PRIME MINISTER AN' NEVER ONCE CAUGHT, WHICH HE INSISTS IZ DA SAME AS BEING INNOCENT. OUTLIVED EVERY FACTION DAT MEANT TA BURY HIM BY BEING DA ONLY PERSON IN DA ROOM WHO REMEMBERED WHAT EVERYONE IN IT HAB PROMISED, AN' TA WHOM, AN' ON WHAT DAY. POWER WEARS OUT; PAPERWORK DOES NOT!
lore.richardBenson: BROADCASTS FROM A TRANSMITTER HE BUILT OUT OF PARTS NOBODY WILL ADMIT SELLIN' HIM, AN' HAB BEEN AT WAR WIT HIS OWN AUDIENCE FOR TWENTY YEARS. FLUENT IN THREE LANGUAGES AN' HOSTILE IN ALL OF DEM. CLAIMS TA HAB INVENTED EVERY GENRE HE PLAYS AN' TA HAB BEEN ROBBED OF DA CREDIT FOR EACH ONE!
lore.ritaLeviMontalcini: DID DA WORK DAT WON HER DA NOBEL IN A BEDROOM LABORATORY, HIDIN' FROM A STATE DAT HAB DECIDED SHE WAZ NOT PERMITTED TA BE A SCIENTIST. NOTHIN' SINCE HAB BEEN ABLE TA IMPRESS HER, INCLUDIN' DA STATE, DA NOBEL, OR HER OWN CENTURY. SENATOR FOR LIFE, AN' STILL DA FIRST ONE AWAKE!
lore.kofiAnnan: SPENT A CAREER STANDIN' BETWEEN PEOPLE WHO HAB ALREADY DECIDED TA KILL EACH OTHER, AN' GOT ENOUGH OF DEM TA STOP DAT DA REST IZ A MATTER OF ARITHMETIC. SPEAKS QUIETLY, ON DA THEORY DAT A ROOM WILL LEAN IN TA HEAR A MAN WHO REFUSES TA SHOUT AT IT!
lore.georgeWBush: INHERITED AN OIL FORTUNE, A FAMILY NAME AN' A COUNTRY IN DAT ORDER, AN' HAB BEEN UNDERESTIMATED BY EVERYONE HE HAB EVER BEATEN. RUNS ON CERTAINTY RATHER DEN ANALYSIS, WHICH IZ A LIABILITY IN PEACETIME AN' SOMETHIN' ELSE ENTIRELY IN A WAR!
lore.berlusconi: OWNS DA CHANNELS DAT REPORT ON HIM, WHICH HE HAB NEVER REGARDED AS A CONFLICT SO MUCH AS AN EFFICIENCY. SELLS OPTIMISM AT SCALE AN' BELIEVES EVERY WORD OF IT WHILE HE IZ SAYIN' IT, WHICH IZ WHAT MAKES IT SELL!
lore.ciampi: SPENT A LIFETIME HOLDIN' DA LIRA TOGETHER AN' DEN SIGNED IT AWAY FOR SOMETHIN' STEADIER, AN' CONSIDERS DAT DA WHOLE OF HIS CAREER RATHER DEN DA END OF IT. CENTRAL BANKERS DO NOT GET STATUES; HE HAB NEVER ONCE SEEMED TA MIND!

0: DA BRANCH BEHIND HER IZ A WORLD WHERE MAGIC WAZ NEVER FILED AWAY AMONG FAIRY TALES BUT LICENSED, TAXED AN' PRINTED IN DA BACK PAGES OF DA NEWSPAPERS!
HER DIMENSION BURNED ITS LAST CATHEDRAL IN 1913 AN' HAB RUN ON BORROWED MIRACLES EVER SINCE!
DA WORLD SHE LEFT WAZ ONE FLOODED CITY NINETY STOREYS TALL, WIT DA SEA HELD BACK BY RECITED LAW!
SHE GREW UP IN A COUNTRY DAT HAB QUIETLY SECEDED FROM GEOGRAPHY AN' COULD ONLY BE REACHED BY GETTIN' LOST ON PURPOSE!
IN HER REALITY DA Y2K EVENT NEVER STOPPED, AN' IT HAB BEEN DA FIRST OF JANUARY FOR EIGHTEEN MONTHS!
HER HOME BRANCH IZ A EUROPE STITCHED TOGETHER OUT OF COMPANY TOWNS, EACH ONE OWNED BY A DIFFERENT SLEEPIN' GOD!
SHE ARRIVES FROM A WORLD WHERE NOBODY DIED BETWEEN 1971 AN' 1994, AN' EVERYONE IZ STILL DECIDIN' WHETHER DAT WAZ A MERCY!
DA DIMENSION BEHIND HER RAN DA SOLOMONIC RITUAL TWELVE TIMES, INDUSTRIALLY, AN' MADE A NATIONAL HOLIDAY OUT OF IT!
HER REALITY NEVER INVENTED DA WHEEL AN' NEVER NEEDED TA, SINCE DISTANCE DERE IZ A MATTER OF PERSUASION!
SHE IZ FROM A TIMELINE WHERE DA MOON IZ A SETTLED PLACE AN' DA NIGHT SKY IZ CROWDED WIT LAMPS DAT ANSWER TA NAMES!
1: DERE SHE WAZ A LICENSED WEATHER-WITCH, SALTIN' CLOUDS FOR FARMIN' CONSORTIA!
SHE SPENT DAT LIFE AS A NIGHT NURSE IN A HOSPICE FOR PEOPLE WHOSE DEATHS HAB GONE MISSIN'!
SHE WAZ DA YOUNGEST ARCHIVIST EVER ADMITTED TA DAT WORLD'S MAGE GUILD, AN' DA ONLY ONE EXPELLED FROM IT TWICE!
IN DAT LIFE SHE WAZ A COURIER, CARRYIN' SEALED WORDS BETWEEN CITIES DAT REFUSED TA SPEAK TA EACH OTHER!
SHE WAZ A HEDGE-WITCH WORKIN' OUT OF A LAUNDRETTE, DOING CURSES AT DA GOING RATE AN' NEVER ASKIN' NAMES!
DERE SHE WAZ CROWNED, BRIEFLY, BY A COUNTRY DAT REGRETTED IT WITHIN DA SEASON!
SHE WAZ DAT WORLD'S LAST PRACTISIN' EXORCIST, MOSTLY EMPLOYED BY LANDLORDS!
SHE MADE HER LIVIN' READIN' DA MARKET BY CANDLELIGHT FOR MEN WHO CALLED IT RESEARCH!
IN DAT BRANCH SHE TAUGHT PRIMARY-SCHOOL ARITHMETIC, AN' QUIETLY HELD DA TOWN'S BRIDGE TOGETHER WIT IT!
SHE WAZ A SOLDIER DERE, IN A WAR FOUGHT ENTIRELY BY CORRESPONDENCE!
2: DEN SOMETHIN' IN DA SKY OPENED A DOOR DAT OPENED DA WRONG WAY, AN' SHE WAZ ON DA FAR SIDE OF IT!
IT ENDED WHEN SHE SIGNED A CONTRACT SHE HAB NOT FINISHED READIN', AN' DA INK OUTLIVED DA WORLD!
DA END CAME AS A SOUND, ONE LONG NOTE, AN' EVERYTHIN' DAT COULD HEAR IT STOPPED BEING DERE!
SHE STEPPED INTO A LIFT GOING DOWN AN' STEPPED OUT SOMEWHERE WIT A DIFFERENT NUMBER OF DIRECTIONS!
A GOD SHE HAB NEVER PETITIONED ANSWERED ANYWAY, AN' DA ANSWER TOOK DA WHOLE STREET WIT IT!
SHE TRADED HER DIMENSION AWAY IN A WAGER SHE STILL INSISTS SHE WON!
DA LIMINAL ENGINE OF DAT WORLD WAZ SWITCHED ON FOR TESTIN', ONCE, AN' SHE WAZ STANDIN' TOO CLOSE!
HER NAME WAZ WRITTEN INTO SOMEONE ELSE'S RITUAL, AN' NAMES IZ POWER, SO SHE WENT WHERE DA NAME WENT!
SOMETHIN' ENORMOUS BEGAN REMEMBERIN' HER, AN' DA PRESSURE OF BEING REMEMBERED PUSHED HER OUT!
SHE FOLLOWED A STRANGER WIT HER OWN FACE THROUGH A GAP IN A HEDGE, AN' DA HEDGE CLOSED!
3: SHE KEPT EVERYTHIN' EXCEPT DA REASON FOR ANY OF IT!
NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF HER MEMORIES WENT INTO DA PAYMENT; SHE DOES NOT KNOW WHICH ONES, ONLY DAT SHE FLINCHES AT CHURCH BELLS!
SHE LOST HER MOTHER TONGUE IN TRANSIT AN' HAB BEEN BORROWIN' DIS ONE EVER SINCE!
WHAT SHE PAID WAZ HER DEATH, WHICH NOW BELONGS TA SOMEBODY ELSE AN' IZ BEING KEPT BADLY!
SHE LEFT WIT DA CLOTHES SHE STOOD IN, A SPEAR SHE NO CAN LIFT, AN' NO PROOF SHE EVER EXISTED!
DA CROSSIN' TOOK HER AGE; SHE IZ THIRTY-SOMETHIN' AN' ELEVEN AT ONCE, DEPENDIN' ON DA HOUR!
SHE SURRENDERED EVERY FACE SHE LOVED, AN' KEPT, USELESSLY, ALL OF DEY BIRTHDAYS!
HER SHADOW STAYED BEHIND, SO SHE HAB LEARNED TA STAND WHERE NOBODY CHECKS!
SHE GAVE UP DA LAST FORTY YEARS OF HER OWN FUTURE AN' HAB NOT DECIDED WHETHER TA MISS DEM!
DA TOLL WAZ HER TALENT, WHICH GREW BACK WRONG, AN' MUCH LARGER!
4: SHE TURNED UP HERE ON A ROAD SHE DOES NOT REMEMBER CHOOSIN', AN' CALLS DAT A BEGINNIN'!
NOW SHE IZ ON DIS BRANCH, CATALOGUIN' DA DIFFERENCES IN A NOTEBOOK SHE HAB ALREADY LOST TWICE!
SHE HAB BEEN HERE ELEVEN DAYS AN' IZ STILL TESTIN' WHICH OF HER SPELLS DA LOCAL PHYSICS WILL TOLERATE!
SHE IZ LOOKIN' FOR DA VERSION OF DIS WORLD WHERE DA DOOR BACK IZ STILL STANDIN' OPEN!
SHE SAYS SHE IZ ONLY PASSIN' THROUGH. SHE HAB SAID DAT IN NINE DIMENSIONS!
SHE HAB DECIDED TA TREAT DIS REALITY AS A FRESH SHEET, AN' TA STOP COUNTIN'!
SHE WOKE ON RITUAL ISLAND WIT DA TIDE OUT, ALONE, AN' STARTED WALKIN' INLAND!
WHAT SHE WANTS HERE IZ SMALL AN' SPECIFIC AN' SHE WILL NOT SAY WHAT IT IZ!
SHE IZ HUNTIN' WHOEVER WROTE HER NAME INTO DAT RITUAL, ACROSS AS MANY WORLDS AS IT TAKES!
FOR NOW SHE WORKS FOR WHOEVER PAYS, AN' ASKS DA LOCALS CAREFUL QUESTIONS ABOUT DEY GODS!

emRestlessLines: ME IZ DA PROTAGONIST. ME IZ NOT BEING MODEST ABOUT IT BECAUSE ME DO NOT SEE DA POINT OF DAT!
ME KNOW A SPELL OR TWO. ME OWN FOUR HUNDRED GRIMOIRES AN' ME HAB READ MOST OF DEM, SO IT IZ RATHER MORE DEN TWO!
DIS GAME IZ PLAYED BETTER FROM ME SIDE OF DA NET. YOU IZ WELCOME TA DA OTHER SIDE!
CHOOSE ME AN' ME PROMISE YOU HOURS OF PROPERLY STRANGE BUSINESS. DAT IZ NOT A FIGURE OF SPEECH. ME HAB CHECKED!
ME IZ IMMORTAL ACROSS DIMENSIONS. TRY TA STOP ME. GENUINELY, TRY, ME WANT TA SEE DA ATTEMPT!
WITCHES NEVER DIES....SOMEBODY EXPLAINED WHY DAT IZ WRONG AN' ME HAB DECIDED TA KEEP IT!
NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF ME MEMORIES WAZ TAKEN AN' ME REMAIN DA STRONGEST THING ON DIS BOARD. CONSIDER WHAT DA OTHER EIGHT PERCENT MUST BE!
STILL WAITIN'. ME HAB ALL DA TIME DERE IZ, TECHNICALLY, AN' A REAL GOOD BACKHAND!
emOriginalLore: BORN IN WIMBLEDON, BRITANNIA, IN 1984, ON DA BRANCH WHERE DA RITUAL ACTUALLY HAPPENED: DIS IZ DIMENSION THREE, DA ORIGINAL. SHE GAVE UP NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF HER MEMORIES TA FORGE DA SPEAR DAT KILLED DA FATHER ASPECT OF YHWH, AN' WOKE ON RITUAL ISLAND WIT NO PAST AN' A MAGICAL POTENTIAL DAT HAB BEEN GROWIN' PAST WHAT SHE CAN HOLD EVER SINCE. EVERY OTHER EM FELL HERE FROM SOMEWHERE ELSE; SHE NEVER HAB ANYWHERE TA FALL FROM!
emBackstory: EM WAZ BORN IN {town}, BRITANNIA, AN' WANTED TA BE A WITCH IN AN AGE DAT HAB FILED MAGIC AWAY WIT DA FAIRY TALES!

WHEN MARGARET THATCHER, QUIETLY ONE OF DA THREE PILLARS OF DA MAGE GUILD, NEEDED A FULCRUM FOR DA SOLOMONIC RITUAL, SHE PICKED EM. EM OFFERED HERSELF AS DA SACRIFICE. DA PRICE WAZ NINETY-TWO PERCENT OF HER MEMORIES!

DEY DID NOT GO ANYWHERE. DEY WAZ FORGED INTO DA LANCE OF MEMORY, DA SPEAR DAT KILLED DA FATHER ASPECT OF YHWH: HIS SOUL WAZ SCATTERED INTO QUADRILLIONS OF FRAGMENTS, HIS ROTTIN' BODY STILL ORBITS DA EARTH, AN' EVERY SACRED SPELL DA VATICAN KNEW STOPPED WORKIN' DAT NIGHT!

SHE DID NOT DIE ON DA TABLE. SHE WOKE ALONE ON RITUAL ISLAND ON DA FIRST OF JANUARY WIT NO PAST AT ALL AN', FOR REASONS NOBODY HAB BEEN ABLE TA EXPLAIN, A MAGICAL POTENTIAL GROWN ENORMOUSLY PAST WHAT SHE STARTED WIT. SHE IZ STILL LEARNIN' TA HOLD IT, AN' IT IZ STILL GROWIN'!

SHE TRAVELS WIT BUBBA AN' DA CAMPER DEY SHARE, POINTED AT BEAGLE FOR AN APPOINTMENT SHE BARELY REMEMBERS. BUBBA FEELS NOTHIN' FOR HER AN' STILL LOVES ERIS; ERIS, GODDESS OF DISCORD AN' CURRENT OCCUPANT OF DA CELESTIAL THRONE, IZ JEALOUS ENOUGH TA BEND COSMIC LAW AN' PROBABILITY TA MAKE EM'S LIFE HELL!
